verdict.rationale: Solid components are plain JavaScript functions that use JSX, so markup and rendering logic live together in one component written in familiar JavaScript/TypeScript (solid-gh-9, solid-gh-11, solid-gh-14, solid-gh-15, solid-gh-17). Hands-on reports from React developers describe it as familiar and easy to port to (solid-comm-4, solid-comm-14). missing for 10: no evidence on how styles are written or colocated in components, and no in-depth first-party docs on component authoring beyond README-level claims.
